implemented_requirements.requirement: Two vertical paddles, one for each player
implemented_requirements.evidence: class Paddle in paddle.py creates a rect and side ('left' or 'right'); Game.__init__ creates self.paddle_left = Paddle('left') and self.paddle_right = Paddle('right')

implemented_requirements.requirement: Paddles can move up and down via player controls (W/S for player 1, Up/Down arrows for player 2)
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game._handle_paddle_input reads pygame.key.get_pressed() and calls self.paddle_left.move_up()/move_down() on K_w/K_s and self.paddle_right.move_up()/move_down() on K_UP/K_DOWN

implemented_requirements.requirement: Ball bounces off the top and bottom edges of the playfield
implemented_requirements.evidence: Ball.update() checks if self.rect.top <= 0 or self.rect.bottom >= settings.SCREEN_HEIGHT and reverses self.velocity_y accordingly

implemented_requirements.requirement: Ball bounces off paddles with angle based on hit position and speed increase
implemented_requirements.evidence: Ball.bounce_off_paddle() computes relative_intersect, bounce_angle, updates self.velocity_x/y and increases self.speed (capped by BALL_MAX_SPEED)

implemented_requirements.requirement: Score a point when the opponent misses the ball (ball leaves the screen)
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game._check_scoring() detects ball.rect.right < 0 or ball.rect.left > settings.SCREEN_WIDTH and increments the opposite player's score

implemented_requirements.requirement: Winning score threshold ends the match and declares a winner
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game._after_point() checks if self.score_left or self.score_right >= settings.WINNING_SCORE, sets self.winner and changes state to STATE_GAME_OVER

implemented_requirements.requirement: Ball is reset after each point with a short serve delay
implemented_requirements.evidence: Ball.reset() positions the ball in the centre, sets serve_timer = settings.SERVE_DELAY_FRAMES; Ball.update() launches after timer reaches 0

implemented_requirements.requirement: Serve direction alternates toward the player who missed the previous point
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game._after_point() calls self.ball.reset(direction) where direction = -1 if serve_towards == 'left' else 1, and Ball.launch() uses self.serve_direction to set initial velocity_x
Game._draw_menu() displays start screen; pressing SPACE in menu or game‑over state triggers Game._start_match()

implemented_requirements.requirement: Visual rendering of paddles, ball, scores and centre line
implemented_requirements.evidence: ui.draw_center_line, ui.draw_score, ui.draw_centered_text, and the draw methods in Paddle and Ball render all elements

judge.summary: The provided source files implement a complete two‑player Pong game meeting all core requirements: controllable paddles, ball physics with wall and paddle bounces, scoring, a configurable winning score, serve delay and reset, and basic UI/menu flow. The code is syntactically correct, uses pygame correctly, and appears ready to run, giving a high functional completeness and executable likelihood.
